description: The man wears a dark moss-green wool tunic with brown-gold knotwork trim at the front opening, cuffs and thigh-length hem. Cream linen shows at the collar, wrists and lower edge. A dark green and muted brown checked cloak rests across his shoulders, fastened by a round knotwork brooch near his left shoulder and hanging in a fringed panel down that side. A decorated brown leather belt has a round buckle and long patterned strap. Brown trousers tuck into dark brown leather boots wrapped with narrow ties. His head and hands remain bare, without weapons or armor.
